title: Prove the P112 right-extension COPY floor with charged auxiliary terms
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2515 leaves charged pure-projection terms outside its sharp P112 right-extension theorem. This closes that exact remaining case: for the fixed completion, left `col_C(X,e0)` and right `col_C(X,e0,e1)`, any finite complex factorization has separate COPY-power bill at least `8*8^q` for every `0<q<=1`. The credited ten-term witness attains it; COPY minimum is 64.

The new lemma proves that an eight-term projected dual basis has at most one cost-seven term, regardless of pure compensation. This uses the shared coordinate support of the fixed exceptional roots. If such a term occurs, the predecessor's rechecked free-pure argument forces a positive pure charge. The proof retains PR2515/PR2398's support and many-mixed-term arguments with attribution.

Only `research/p112-charged-right-extension/` is added. This is a scoped written proof with exact finite premises, not a physical supplier or kappa improvement. Separate billing, the fixed coefficient/port pair and both factor spaces remain essential. Native frames, dirty restoration, physical sharing, hosting, precision/reserve and all-size transfer remain unproved. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

- Base canonical main `6ca6f217708b075814de409ad693fea9a2aaa760`, priority 5; final checkpoint `84f8e607779b81c05edc962d4981d1f9b4b9bc9f` leaves guidance, selected record, input and runner unchanged.
- Exact predecessors: PR2515 `92231f9e4a4737aaae21e2bc01f4d3dee5ead140`; PR2398 `8051d99dfd91a788d25bfc92c3863a33c658a5a9`. Their proof texts are retained byte-for-byte; executables are not imported.
- The drawn `complex-rank-shape-decoder` scope was explicitly **changed** to this precise algebraic handoff. No physical 5% gate is claimed. Full scope, nonce, boundaries and stop rule are in TASK.json.
- [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2006#discussioncomment-18959554). Final overlap: 724 open PRs including drafts and 1435 Discussion records, complete pagination, with exact timestamps/limits in TASK.json. PR2724 concerns a rank-eight realization with nine terms, a different model from this fixed rank-nine completion.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-charged-right-extension
```

Passes on Windows / CPython 3.12.14, standard library only; normal CPython 3.14.6 regeneration agrees. Checks cover 1,022 rational support kernels with independent modular rank certificates, 110 pairings using two binary rank engines, all 169 ordered cost-seven dual conflicts, six rational fixtures / 75,264 matrix entries and nine controls. The PR2321 charged-pure fixture is accepted with its actual rank-one charge. All four actual-CLI test groups pass: optimized Git-free relocation, source/receipt corruption, full regeneration and exclusive output. Windows sandbox runs used writable workspace TEMP/TMP. `git diff --check` passes.

Finite replay supports the written complex proof; no formal-kernel, independent human, hosted-CI or selected full cold-replay result is claimed.

## Credit and next question

ywz65/PR2515 supplied the extension, free-pure theorem and charged-pure handoff; commdata2338/PR2021/PR2398 supplied the completion and boundary; Hanhong Zhao/PR2321 supplied the nine-term attainer. The README retains the geometry/support and icekylinx prototype lineage. Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, checking and writing; Apache-2.0.

This closes the fixed-space route. A proposed two-sided extension must first recompute its support kernels and price every pure term; no further same-space optimization is justified by this result. The structured next question and physical blockers are in TASK.json.
